problem: His answer so far: hire someone who knows computers
action: Inside the office. A younger man in his twenties sits at the desk working at a laptop, absorbed, his back half to us. The dealer stands behind and to one side of him with his arms folded, watching the screen over the younger man's shoulder. The dealer's expression is patient but shut out — he is paying for something he cannot follow.
lighting: Cool light from the laptop on the young man's face, warmer window light on the dealer standing behind. The dealer is slightly further from the light and reads as the outsider in his own office.
camera: Waist-up two-shot, the young man seated lower and in the foreground left, the dealer standing upper right. Sharp on the dealer. 35mm.
detail: The laptop screen is completely DARK and blank — no interface, no text, no glow of content, no logos. No brand mark on the laptop lid. Same cream full-sleeve shirt with the sleeves rolled, same dark navy trousers, same watch.
feeling: Paying fifteen thousand a month to not understand your own pump.
motion: The young man's hands move slightly on the keyboard. The dealer shifts his weight and keeps watching. A slow push in on the dealer. No cuts, no camera shake, nobody speaks, no faces turn to camera.

voice_over.hi: एक आदमी रखा। पंद्रह हज़ार महीना, सुबह दस से शाम पाँच।
